fusions.name: Anvil Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls an iron weight up to 7 tiles for 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Cold Knuckle
fusions.desc: A heavy knuckle blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Silverback Wall
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold-Forged Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 12% arcane resistance.
